title: Demand Response Programs — Schedule of Under-Delivery Charges and Negative Balance Settlement
content:
**Charges.** The Demand Response Programs charge for under-delivery at the rates below, subject to the monthly limit stated for each program, and settle a negative incentive balance as shown in the last column.

| Program | Shortfall charge per kW short of the commitment in an event | Excess energy charge per kWh used above the firm service level in an event | Limit on penalties in a program month | Negative incentive balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | $0.00 | $0.00 | No penalties | Not applicable; the balance cannot fall below zero |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | $0.00 | $0.00 | No penalties | Billed to the service agreement when the enrollment ends |
| AC Cycling Program | $0.00 | $0.00 | No penalties | Billed to the service agreement when the enrollment ends |
| Home Battery Dispatch | $0.00 | $0.00 | No penalties | Not applicable; the balance cannot fall below zero |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | $8.50 per kW | $0.00 | Penalties in a program month never exceed that month's capacity payment | Billed to the service agreement at the end of the program month |
| Base Interruptible Program | $0.00 | $6.00 per kWh | No cap | Billed to the service agreement at the end of the program month |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Only the two business programs carry an under-delivery charge: the Commercial Capacity Bidding Program a shortfall charge of $8.50 per kW, and the Base Interruptible Program an excess energy charge of $6.00 per kWh.
2. The Commercial Capacity Bidding Program's penalties in any one program month are limited to that month's capacity payment. The Base Interruptible Program's excess energy charges carry no cap.
3. A negative incentive balance on a Smart Thermostat Rewards or AC Cycling Program enrollment is billed to the service agreement when the enrollment ends. On a Commercial Capacity Bidding Program or Base Interruptible Program enrollment it is billed to the service agreement at the end of the program month. Peak Time Rebate and Home Battery Dispatch balances cannot fall below zero.

## Settlement timing at a glance

| Program | When a negative balance is billed |
|---|---|
| Smart Thermostat Rewards, AC Cycling Program | When the enrollment ends |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program, Base Interruptible Program | At the end of the program month |
| Peak Time Rebate, Home Battery Dispatch | Never; the balance cannot fall below zero |
